transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad all the time. It has been going on like this for over two years now, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy mood.

During these past two years, have you experienced any periods of a few weeks or longer where your mood felt even lower, or have you felt this same level of sadness consistently throughout the entire time?

Honestly, it has felt pretty much exactly the same the entire time. I haven't had any breaks or periods where it got noticeably better or worse; it's just been this constant, heavy sadness every single day.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a chronic, consistent low mood lasting over two years without periods of remission or episodes of significantly more severe depression. This clinical presentation is highly characteristic of Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia). Major Depressive Disorder is less likely given the lack of distinct episodic exacerbations.
